sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:70

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:70:1
items.html:
When Malchut rose to Daat, the record rose with her as well: The matter of the ascent of Malchut and of the record in the coupling of the five Hassadim and the five Gevurot of Daat requires a broad explanation, and it will be explained in its place; here I shall come only briefly. For you know that the whole matter of those four kings that expanded, both from AVI and from YESHSUT, is a matter of the refinement of the screen and the departure of the lights, in the manner explained in the previous Partzufim of AK. And when the screen of AVI was refined until it became equal to the root, which is the Peh [mouth] of AVI, the screen and the records in it then returned in the secret of the inclusion of the coupling of AVI, and the screen thickened again with the coarseness of phase two, since the last phase is lost, and the level of YESHSUT came out upon it. Now, the screen of YESHSUT too was refined from degree to degree until it reached the level of Malchut, and then the seventh king, which is Malchut, came out. And after this king broke, the screen was found to have been refined also of the coarseness of Malchut, and it was then found to be equal to the phase of its root, which is the Peh of YESHSUT, and it there made a new coupling with the coarseness of phase one, since the last phase is lost. Therefore the level of Daat, which is the level of ZA, came out upon it there. And from this coupling no complete Partzuf of Rosh [head] and Guf [body] expanded, for it came out only with the five Hassadim and the five Gevurot alone, the two crowns, and therefore it came out only in the phase of from below upward, from the phase of back to back. It therefore bound VAK together, meaning the phase of the Gufim that had come out in YESHSUT, which are from the Chazeh [chest] downward, for there is the phase of its expansion, from the Peh of YESHSUT downward.
And this is what he says: “Then Daat expanded through this bond and illuminated in VAK,” as above, that it expanded from the Chazeh downward, where the place of the Peh of YESHSUT is, that is, in the place of NHY, for that is its place, namely below the Rosh of YESHSUT. And since it came out in the phase of back to back, it therefore had in it the correction of the lines, as above. And this is what he says: “The record that is in Gevura illuminated in the left line and left Hod there in its place … and drew Netzah there,” for the Rosh of the lower one clothes and fills the vessels and the records of the upper one, as is known. Therefore it illuminated in the records of the kings Netzah and Hod and imparted to them the correction of the lines, and by this the correction of the lines expanded also from the Chazeh downward and enlarged the vessels down to the place of Netzah and Hod, so that the correction of the lines was already completed in all of ZAT with respect to the records in them. For HGT were corrected in the Rosh of YESHSUT, as above, and NH were corrected in the Rosh of Daat, that is, in its phase of from below upward, as explained.
